title: Russia's Biggest Bank Sberbank Wins Approval to Trade Bitcoin
message_html: Russia's Biggest Bank Sberbank Wins Approval to Trade Bitcoin ...
snippet: Sberbank now holds both custody and exchange status under Russia's new crypto law, and plans to bring Bitcoin, Ethereum and USDT to apps used by 110 million retail clients.

title: EBA classifies USDC as significant e-money token under MiCA
message_html: EBA classifies USDC as significant e-money token under MiCA ...
snippet: The European Banking Authority (EBA) has classified USDC, issued by Circle Internet Financial Europe SAS, as a significant e-money token (EMT) under the Markets in Crypto Assets Regulation (MiCA), following its assessment of the criteria set out in the Regulation.
